ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
var html=String(result);
var m=html.match(/<script[^>]*id=["']__NUXT_DATA__["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);
var list=[];
if(m){
  var raw=JSON.parse(m[1]);
  function dr1(o){
    if(typeof o==='number'&&o>=0&&o<raw.length)return raw[o];
    return o
  }
  var d3=raw[3];
  var srKey='';
  for(var k in d3){if(k.indexOf('search')===0||k==='searchResults'){srKey=k;break}}
  if(srKey){
    var srObj=dr1(d3[srKey]);
    var srList=dr1(srObj.list);
    list=srList.map(function(it){
      it=dr1(it);
      return{
        name:dr1(it.title)||'',
        author:dr1(it.author)||'',
        bookUrl:'https://www.tingyou.fm/albums/'+dr1(it.id),
        coverUrl:dr1(it.cover)||'',
        intro:dr1(it.desc)||''
      }
    })
  }
}
JSON.stringify(list)
</js>

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var html=String(result);
var m=html.match(/<script[^>]*id=["']__NUXT_DATA__["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);

  if(tabsKey){
    var tabs=dr1(d3[tabsKey]);
    var tabKey='recommend';
    var mt=baseUrl.match(/[?&]tab=([^&\\/]+)/);
    if(mt){var tk=mt[1];if(tabs[tk]){tabKey=tk}}
    var tab=dr1(tabs[tabKey]);

      it=dr1(it);

}

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
var html=String(result);
var m=html.match(/<script[^>]*id=["']__NUXT_DATA__["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);
if(!m){''}else{
  var raw=JSON.parse(m[1]);
  function dr1(o){
    if(typeof o==='number'&&o>=0&&o<raw.length)return raw[o];
    return o
  }
  var d3=raw[3];
  var adKey='';
  for(var k in d3){if(k.indexOf('album-detail')===0){adKey=k;break}}
  if(!adKey){''}else{
    var a=dr1(d3[adKey]);
    dr1(a.synopsis)||''
  }
}
</js>
ruleBookInfo.lastChapter:
<js>
var html=String(result);
var m=html.match(/<script[^>]*id=["']__NUXT_DATA__["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);
if(!m){''}else{
  var raw=JSON.parse(m[1]);
  function dr1(o){
    if(typeof o==='number'&&o>=0&&o<raw.length)return raw[o];
    return o
  }
  var d3=raw[3];
  var acKey='';
  for(var k in d3){if(k.indexOf('album-chapters')===0){acKey=k;break}}
  if(!acKey){''}else{
    var c=dr1(d3[acKey]);
    var chaptersArr=dr1(c.chapters)||[];
    if(chaptersArr.length>0){
      var lastCh=dr1(chaptersArr[chaptersArr.length-1]);
      dr1(lastCh.title)||''
    }else{''}
  }
}
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var html=String(result);
var m=html.match(/<script[^>]*id=["']__NUXT_DATA__["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/);
var list=[];
if(m){
  var raw=JSON.parse(m[1]);
  function dr1(o){
    if(typeof o==='number'&&o>=0&&o<raw.length)return raw[o];
    return o
  }
  var d3=raw[3];
  var acKey='';
  for(var k in d3){if(k.indexOf('album-chapters')===0){acKey=k;break}}
  if(acKey){
    var c=dr1(d3[acKey]);
    var chaptersArr=dr1(c.chapters)||[];
    var aid=dr1(c.id);
    list=chaptersArr.map(function(chRef){
      var ch=dr1(chRef);
      var idx=dr1(ch.index);
      var title=dr1(ch.title);
      return{
        name:title||('第'+idx+'集'),
        url:'https://www.tingyou.fm/audios/'+aid+'/'+idx
      }
    })
  }
}
JSON.stringify(list)
</js>
